releases.body:
Fixes TUI loading from npm by shipping compiled JavaScript. Version 0.1.2 shipped raw TSX, which OpenCode could try to load as React inside node_modules.

The OpenTUI Solid build now produces both package entrypoints.

Repeatable checks:
- `npm run verify:static`: typecheck, build, pack, and validate exported JavaScript.
- `npm run verify:live -- --packed`: verify the packed artifact in a real TUI.
- `npm run verify:live`: verify the installed npm package.

Both static and packed live checks passed. Published the exact verified tarball.

Install with `opencode plugin add @op1/opencode-subagent-model@0.1.3`.

Published as `@op1/opencode-subagent-model@0.1.2` on npm for OpenCode 2.0.3.

Install with `opencode plugin add @op1/opencode-subagent-model@0.1.2`. Source and package metadata now point to `opzero1/opencode-subagent-model`.

Typechecking passed, and the package contains both the server and TUI entrypoints.
